messages:
maria: New hire reports onboarding sample app fails on Cloudflare Workers when importing our JS SDK. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/tree/main/worker-sample

devon: What's the runtime error they see?

maria:
Error: Uncaught TypeError: default is not a constructor
Snippet they used:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
```

aj: Classic ESM/CJS interop. Workers require ESM; if exports resolve to a CJS bundle consumers get a module shape mismatch.

sophia: I inspected the published package: exports currently point at a single cjs entry under "default". Some edge runtimes/bundlers then end up loading CJS.

maria: This breaks first-run onboarding which is really bad UX for new hires. Can we patch quickly?

devon: Proposal: replace current exports with conditional map: import -> dist/index.esm.mjs, require -> dist/index.cjs.js, types -> dist/index.d.ts, plus ./edge -> dist/index.edge.mjs for worker-optimized build. Example: 
{
  ".": {"types":"./dist/index.d.ts","import":"./dist/index.esm.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"},"./edge":"./dist/index.edge.mjs","./package.json":"./package.json"
}

aj: Add typesVersions fallback for older TS so editors pick up declarations. Also ensure the ESM build has an export default for `import X from` interop (or document named import).

sophia: If we ship edge artifact, run a minimal bundling step to tree-shake node-only deps and strip optional requires. CI should include an esbuild bundle + node-based worker runner smoke test.

maria: I'll mark the onboarding checklist as blocked until we ship a fix. Please tag the doc owner when PR is open.

devon: Opening PR now with package.json exports change, a small tidy to the rollup/esbuild output to produce edge ESM, and a CI smoke test that bundles the sample and runs it against a local worker runner. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/701

ci-bot: buildkite: unit tests passed on main; no worker smoke tests were configured previously.

aj: One more note: auth/retry glue might behave slightly differently in the edge bundle if we polyfill fetch vs native fetch; ensure retry tokens and backoff logic are identical. We should add a short matrix test comparing host vs edge behavior for auth retry headers.

sophia: Agreed 100. Edge build must not accidentally change auth header ordering or swallow retries.

maria: Thanks team. Will test the PR once it merges and update onboarding doc.
